It’s in a small cut out with clearly marked arrows pointing to which way the entrance is, in addition to the fact that since this is a drive up ATM it makes sense for the machine to be on the left side where the driver would be sitting. That said, it’s very easy for people to turn I to the outcropping the wrong way. This happened today while I went to get some cash. I arrived at my bank and as I took the turn to go into the ATM cut out, another car whipped into it going the wrong way so that their passenger could use the ATM. I was annoyed at this as I was just about to pull up to it and I was in kind of a hurry, since I needed to get to class. She took 15 minutes to do her transactions. She went through at least 3 cards inserting and reinserting the cards at least 2 times each. I sat patiently, yet annoyed, and waited for her to finish. I told my friend about this when I eventually arrived at class and he told me that I was being a dick for not just backing up since there was no one behind me. However I stick to the notion that I was in the right for not moving because they were going against traffic. AITA?
